title: Following someone in a room through the reader state API, proven with two learners

tasks.title: Follow, follow again and lead in the room's context
Two learners on the harness with a local relay and server; the real-reader journeys written and disabled

acs.text: WHEN the viewer is in a room's context and following THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the followed person's moves through `host.reader.state.applySnapshot` with origin `follow`: the spotlight holder by default, or the participant the viewer picked with Follow in the presence list.
scenarios: Following the leader, or someone picked

acs.text: WHEN the viewer moves in the reader themselves while following THE SYSTEM SHALL stop applying, say they are on their own with a "Follow again" button, and pressing it applies the followed person's current place at once and goes on following.
WHEN the viewer presses Lead in the room's context THE SYSTEM SHALL ask the room for the spotlight, and while they hold it their moves are published to those who follow.

WHEN two viewers are in one room on the harness (local relay, local server, real Postgres) and the leader moves THE SYSTEM SHALL move the follower's reader to the same place; a refresh of the follower's `ctx` address reconnects and keeps following; Back takes the follower out of the room; and the follower's own `sefaria.settings` slice is unchanged.
scenarios: Two learners in one room on the harness
